title: Robust Finite-Momentum Instabilities in Dense Matter
summary: The predicted extent of inhomogeneous chiral phases in effective models of quantum chromodynamics is notoriously sensitive to ultraviolet regularization. We show that this sensitivity is largely artificial. In the two-flavor Nambu--Jona-Lasinio model, conventional implementations of three-dimensional cutoff, Pauli--Villars, and proper-time regularization produce strongly different finite-momentum instability regions.
